_comment: Fictional project-tracker data for the SpecLens demo. Matches the fictional Northwind Freight sample documents (requirement IDs, people, dates). Not real data.

issues.summary: Customer creates a booking in the portal
issues.description: Booking form with pickup address, drop address, pickup date, cargo type and weight.

issues.summary: Booking confirmation by email and SMS within 2 minutes
issues.description: Send confirmation through the TextFlow SMS gateway and email after a booking is submitted.

issues.summary: Limit a booking to 20 consignments
issues.description: Block adding a 21st consignment with a clear message.

issues.summary: Cancellation fee of 15% within 6 hours of pickup
issues.description: Free cancellation up to 6 hours before pickup; after that charge 15% of the quoted freight.

issues.summary: Prevent assigning a truck below the booking weight
issues.description: Dispatcher cannot assign a truck whose registered capacity is lower than the booking weight.

issues.summary: Dispatch lead approval for hazardous cargo bookings
issues.description: Blocked: waiting for Northwind to confirm who approves when the Dispatch lead is on leave.

issues.summary: Driver app sends GPS location every 5 minutes
issues.description: Background location updates while a trip is in progress.

issues.summary: Tracking link by SMS at pickup with ETA
issues.description: Public tracking page showing latest location and estimated time of arrival.

issues.summary: Capture e-POD with photo and signature
issues.description: Driver app captures a photo of the delivered goods and the recipient's signature.

issues.summary: Store e-PODs offline and sync when the network returns
issues.description: Queue e-PODs on the device when there is no network and upload them automatically later.

issues.summary: Mark shipment Delivered only after e-POD upload
issues.description: Shipment status changes to Delivered when the e-POD upload succeeds.

issues.summary: Invoice scheduler: generate invoice within 24 hours of e-POD upload
issues.description: Nightly and hourly jobs generate the customer invoice within 24 hours of the e-POD upload.

issues.summary: Invoices in INR with 18% GST
issues.description: Invoice template and tax calculation.

issues.summary: Finance Manager approval for credit notes above INR 50,000
issues.description: Credit notes above the limit wait in an approval queue.

issues.summary: Nightly export of invoices and credit notes to Tally ERP at 23:00 IST
issues.description: Blocked: Northwind has not shared Tally API credentials (risk R-07).

issues.summary: Delayed shipments dashboard refreshed every 15 minutes
issues.description: Operations dashboard listing shipments past their estimated time of arrival.

issues.summary: Weekly carrier performance report email (Mondays 08:00 IST)
issues.description: Scheduled report to the Head of Operations.

issues.summary: Monthly ageing report of unpaid invoices as Excel
issues.description: Finance download of unpaid invoices grouped by age.

issues.summary: CR-003: finance review queue and 48-hour invoice window
issues.description: Add a finance review step for e-POD photos and move invoice generation to within 48 hours of e-POD upload, as approved in CR-003.

issues.summary: Sign-in with password and SMS one-time code; 30-minute session timeout
issues.description: Two-factor sign-in and idle session expiry.

issues.summary: Cancellation fee shown only after the customer confirms
issues.description: Found in UAT (TC-B-03): the 15% fee should be shown before the customer confirms the cancellation.

issues.summary: Offline e-PODs fail to upload after 20 are queued
issues.description: Found in UAT (TC-T-04): uploads fail once more than 20 e-PODs are stored offline; the requirement is 50.

issues.summary: Invoices generated before finance has reviewed the e-POD
issues.description: Found in UAT (TC-I-01): invoice created 3 hours after e-POD upload with no finance review, following the old 24-hour rule.

testRuns.title: Create a booking and receive confirmation
testRuns.comment: Confirmation SMS arrived in under a minute.

testRuns.title: Cancel 3 hours before pickup
testRuns.comment: Fee appears only after the cancellation is confirmed.

testRuns.title: Truck position updates on the dashboard
Offline e-PODs upload after reconnecting
testRuns.comment: 21st and later e-PODs failed to upload.

testRuns.title: Invoice after e-POD upload and finance review
testRuns.comment: GST correct, but the invoice was generated before finance review (old 24-hour rule).

testRuns.title: Credit note above INR 50,000 waits for approval
